limitations: 22 catalog assets require shared source assembly artwork with blue fitting labels; they are not isolated fitting drawings.
Full/tight/mitered and vane variants use generic source art and must not be interpreted as distinct illustrated geometry.
Original legacy manifest reference crops were incomplete; all review references in this report use recovered complete original XLS raster crops.

excludedExperiments.reason: Isolated redraw attempts changed neck proportions, inferred junctions, or lost an opening; superseded by complete faithful source context.
Lost Q elbow and introduced bolted collar.
Retained excess scan speckles; superseded by cleaner second restoration.

promptSet.common: Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithfully restore exact source HVAC technical drawing to high-resolution crisp thin uniform black lines on pure white. Preserve geometry, topology, perspective, proportions, all visible openings, seams and side attachment surfaces. Straighten straight edges and smooth curves; no shading or redesign. Complete framing with white margin.
promptSet.standalone: Remove source blue fitting labels and unrelated leaders only; preserve meaningful source vane marks and both mirror-image views for V.
promptSet.sharedContext: Restore COMPLETE original reducing trunk and all branches exactly, retain original blue fitting labels. Do not isolate or move branches. Remove only clipped unrelated diagram fragments.

targetedCorrections.context-3O-3Q-v2: Retain Q one ribbed elbow, P two ribbed elbows; no bolted collars.
targetedCorrections.context-3R-3U-v2: Remove all scan speckles and jagged doubled stray marks while preserving seams/opening rims.
